reason: A DSH profile plugin that embeds agent preset selection in the new-session sidebar button and synchronizes it with the existing settings and empty-session preset state.

summaries.zh: 将 Agent 预设选择菜单嵌入 DSH 侧边栏的新会话按钮，并与设置页及当前空白会话保持同步。
summaries.en: Embeds an Agent preset menu in DSH’s sidebar new-session button and synchronizes selections with settings and the current empty session.

capabilities: Modifies the new-session button UI to expose agent preset selection
Reads and writes the global default agent preset
Applies the selected default preset to the current empty session
Discovers available agent presets for display
